Chapter 415: Chapter 21: The Gift From The Supreme Being (Subscription Requested)

Chapter 415: Chapter 21: The Gift from the Supreme Being (Subscription Requested)

“A Supreme Being wishes to see me?”

Lin Yuan felt waves stirring in his spirit, as Supreme Beings were the towering pillars of human civilization.

Today, human civilization could sweep across the Myriad Clans, led by three Goddesses and supported by nine Supreme Beings’ pinnacle combat powers.

Without Supreme Beings, human civilization simply couldn’t counter the Insect Race’s ‘Sea of Bugs’ army.

“Yes, the Supreme Being who wishes to see you is named ‘Xia Qin,'” answered the Goddess of Wisdom.

“Xia Qin Supreme Being…”

...

Lin Yuan’s thoughts scattered; Xia Qin Supreme Being was the third Supreme Being of human civilization, stationed in the Evolution Tower within the northeastern region of the Human Civilization Territory, facing two Peak Clans alone.

“How will I see him?”

Lin Yuan asked.

“You can meet in the Virtual World,” replied the Goddess of Wisdom, her voice solemn and cold.

“Understood.”

Lin Yuan nodded.

It was within Lin Yuan’s expectations that a Supreme Being wished to see him.

As Lin Yuan’s strength continually improved, it was bound to attract the attention of a Supreme Being.

Below the Eighth Layer, Sixth and Seventh Rank were not even noticed by Supreme Beings, but reaching the Eighth Layer… that already constituted high-end combat power of human civilization.

And Lin Yuan’s age upon entering the Eighth Layer was exceedingly young, under a hundred years old, to be precise, just over thirty.

Even if Supreme Beings were not yet paying attention to Lin Yuan, once he became an invincible Eighth Layer and entered the Ninth Rank, he still would need to meet a Supreme Being.

…

A mysterious Virtual World.

Lin Yuan’s form appeared as he looked around.

In the distance, a towering man stood. To call him towering was actually an understatement as he was only three meters tall, but to Lin Yuan, he felt immensely towering, far surpassing tens of thousands of stars combined.

“Supreme Being…”

Lin Yuan scrutinized the towering man, feeling his soul tremble. On this towering man, it seemed as though he saw the vast Cosmic Starry Sky, an endless operation of the Origin Source.

“Space Rules? Rule of Time? No, it’s the Space-Time Rule formed after the fusion of Space Rules and Rule of Time? And the Rule of Life, Rule of Cause and Effect… too many, too many…”

Although Lin Yuan stiffly tried to comprehend with his Against-Heaven’s Understanding, he found it barely effective.

The gap between them was too vast. Lin Yuan was able to understand the paths of the Evolution contained in that segment of the body because the other party had completely perished.

And a Supreme Being had paid a price to forcibly reveal the mysteries contained within that segment of the body.

Additionally, because of the isolation by the Virtual World.

That allowed Seventh Rank Evolvers among humans to comprehend it. Without the above preparations, if that segment of the body were brought directly for comprehension, presumably all Sixth and Seventh Rank Evolvers would go mad at just a glance at it.

Now, Lin Yuan trying to comprehend ‘Xia Qin’ Supreme Being was like directly trying to understand the Origin operation of the Cosmic Starry Sky, hardly understanding anything significant in a short time.

“Interesting little fellow,”

Xia Qin Supreme Being observed Lin Yuan and said with a smile.

“I have seen the Supreme Being,”

Lin Yuan said respectfully immediately.

“It’s terrifying, the different rules can actually fuse together?” Lin Yuan subtly saw a path to the Ninth and even Tenth Rank from the Supreme Being.

An Eighth Rank Evolver eager to advance to the Ninth Rank needed not only a well-perfected Inner World but also Fusion Rules.

Chikun Star Lord was stuck here, with the fusion of Space Rules and Fire Rules not reaching perfect fusion.

But on Xia Qin Supreme Being, Lin Yuan felt many rules merging into one, even the foundational Space and Time Rules perfectly fused into the Space-Time Rule.

“You have a fine talent and know the second method to comprehend that segment of the body. You must also know of the Magic Jade Tower’s existence? You should possess an off-world opportunity?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being casually mentioned.

“Yes,”

Lin Yuan immediately responded,

feeling startled inside.

The Magic Jade Tower, Xia Qin Supreme Being also knew about the Magic Jade Tower?

All along, Lin Yuan had thought only he knew about the Magic Jade Tower, but now it seemed, the Supreme Beings of human civilization had long been aware of it.

As for the ‘off-world opportunity’ Xia Qin Supreme Being mentioned… although not very precise, the Door to the Myriad Realms should also be considered an ‘off-world opportunity’?

“The Insect Race, those old folks, I don’t know from where they learned that a corpse of a Magic Jade Tower Supreme Being was about to drift in…”

“The Magic Jade Tower… is an ancient force. Their Tower Master disappeared for who knows how many years, and most of their members have also mostly kept out of sight…”

Xia Qin Supreme Being said, slightly emotional.

Lin Yuan silently listened below.

The pressure from the Supreme Being was just too great, and from Xia Qin Supreme Being’s tone, the so-called ‘off-world opportunity’ wasn’t taken seriously.

Of course, Lin Yuan was certain that the Supreme Being likely had not discovered the existence of the Door to the Myriad Realms.

So far, of all the existences Lin Yuan had encountered, only the towering Door to the Myriad Realms deep in his mind could compare with the current Xia Qin Supreme Being.

However, the Door to the Myriad Realms in his mind was merely an insignificant projection of the true Door to the Myriad Realms, and in terms of hierarchy, the Door to the Myriad Realms was even above the Supreme Being.

“And your Spirit Will…”

Xia Qin Supreme Being continued observing Lin Yuan, and in a trance, Time Fluctuation began to change.

“If I’m not mistaken, the ages experienced by your Spirit Will should be different from your Physical Soul, right?”

Xia Qin Supreme Being said with a smile.

As a being who fully mastered the Rule of Time, Xia Qin Supreme Being only needed a brief observation of Lin Yuan to notice the differences in the passage of time on his body.

“The ages experienced by the Spirit Will?”

Lin Yuan was slightly startled.

He had traveled seven times, experiencing over a thousand years in reality, but he had never told anyone about this, even the Chikun Star Lord…
